services.desc: Last weeks cold front and rain has really stirred up the water off St. Petersburg and Clearwater. BAIT is everywhere. Quality bait. Thread-fins are all over the beaches and piled up around the Skyway. Blue runners are also easily found in HUGE numbers in the shipping lanes and just west of the beaches. With that come the Kingfish & Spanish Mackerel. During Last Weekends Wild West Kingfish Tournament We ran 2 boats. Our 39′ Contender “Stiff Competition” and our 37′ Spectre “Island Lure”. Both with Great success. We ran a group of Veterans on the Spectre for the people over at AnglerArmory.com with Capt. Tommy Butler & Mate Michael Watts.
